description: Search the Italian normative corpus (laws, codes, Gazzetta Ufficiale acts) by text, meaning or both. Hybrid mode fuses full-text (italian) and vector ranking with reciprocal rank fusion. Parameters: query (words; web-search syntax: "exact phrase", word OR word, -excluded), lexical_raw (Postgres tsquery for prefix and distance, e.g. licenz:* or licenza <2> edilizia; replaces the lexical side), k (1..50, default 10), mode (hybrid, lexical, semantic), filters collection, act (act URN without the article part), article_num, date_from and date_to (YYYY-MM-DD, version date, inclusive). At least a query or one filter is required; filters alone list matches ordered by URN. Example: {"query": "licenza edilizia", "collection": "NORMATTIVA", "k": 5}.
